review.fitness_expert_summary: Poor exercise ordering with isolation before compound movements, and muscle targeting issues. The workout starts with lat pulldowns but then fragments into small isolation moves instead of building compound pulling strength. Face Pull targeting biceps instead of rear delts is a classification error.
review.product_engineer_summary: Exercise classification and ordering logic needs fixes - Face Pull should target rear delts not biceps, and compound movements should be prioritized over isolation in the selection algorithm. The exercise ordering violates compound-first principles.

issues.description: Small isolation movement placed second after a compound lat pulldown instead of building compound pulling volume first.
issues.fix_suggestion: Modify exercise ordering algorithm in SmartExerciseSelectionEngine to prioritize compound movements before isolation regardless of muscle group.

issues.description: Bicep isolation placed third in workout before establishing compound pulling base with rows or pull-ups.
issues.fix_suggestion: Strengthen compound-first ordering rule in WorkoutComboRules to defer isolation work until after 2-3 compound movements.

issues.description: Face Pull incorrectly classified as targeting biceps when it should target rear delts and rhomboids.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update exercise database classification for Face Pull variations to primary_muscles=['Rear Delts'] and secondary_muscles=['Rhomboids', 'Mid Traps'].

issues.description: Second trap-focused movement after Scapula Elevation Depression creates redundant shoulder elevation pattern.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add trap movement frequency cap in SmartExercisePairingEngine to limit shoulder elevation exercises to 1 per back workout.

issues.description: Only 1 true compound pulling movement (lat pulldown) for a back-focused workout - insufficient volume for intermediate trainee.
issues.fix_suggestion: Increase minimum compound movement count for back workouts to 2-3 in SmartExerciseSelectionEngine back workout templates.

improvement_suggestions.title: Fix Face Pull exercise classification in database
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Face Pull is a posterior chain/rear delt exercise that balances pressing movements, not a bicep exercise. This misclassification leads to poor workout balance.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: FoundationalExerciseDatabase.swift - update Face Pull entries to target rear delts/rhomboids

improvement_suggestions.title: Strengthen compound-first ordering algorithm
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Multiple isolation exercises appearing before adequate compound work violates fundamental exercise science principles and reduces workout effectiveness.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: SmartExerciseSelectionEngine.swift - modify exercise selection scoring to heavily weight compound movements in first 2-3 positions

improvement_suggestions.title: Increase minimum compound movement requirement for back workouts
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Back training requires multiple pulling patterns (vertical and horizontal) to adequately stimulate the large muscle mass, especially for intermediate trainees.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: WorkoutComboRules.swift - set minCompoundMovements >= 2 for back-focused workout types

kept_or_swap.rationale: Exercise classification errors and poor compound-to-isolation ordering require major fixes before this workout pattern should be recommended.
